rules.infinite_in_degree: 54 < 72 <= minimum density degree of X_1(95) (Corollary 4.10 with p = 3, limiting newform 95.2.l.a)
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of degree <= 54: 54 < 72 <= minimum density degree of X_1(95) (Corollary 4.10 with p = 3, limiting newform 95.2.l.a)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of degree 54 on X_1(95), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family
